meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能接入 Slack：在私聊里发消息给你，也能按配置在频道/私聊中收发消息，需先建好 Slack 应用并填好密钥。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Slack（如“添加 Slack 频道”“配置 Slack 集成”），或在 /setup 流程中走到这一环时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Slack 集成，用 Socket Mode
say.note: 会复制适配器并引导你创建 Slack 应用、填令牌。

say.text: 接入 Slack 频道，改用 Webhook 接收事件
say.note: 会要求公网 HTTPS 地址并配置事件订阅。

say.text: 验证一下 Slack 连接，然后重启服务
say.note: 会校验令牌、解析你的私聊频道并重启。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can integrate with Slack: it sends you messages in direct messages, and can exchange messages on channels/DMs once configured. You need to create a Slack app and provide the credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Slack integration (e.g. "add Slack channel", "set up Slack"), or while continuing the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add Slack integration using Socket Mode.
say_en.note: It copies the adapter and walks you through creating the Slack app.

say_en.text: Connect Slack using webhook delivery instead.
say_en.note: It asks for a public HTTPS URL and configures event subscriptions.

say_en.text: Validate the Slack connection and restart the service.
say_en.note: It checks the token, resolves your DM channel, and restarts.
